patterns.note: Content is presented in full-screen, centered blocks with vast amounts of negative space, creating a highly focused and minimalist presentation.
Main statements utilize extremely large, bold sans-serif typography that dominates the screen, emphasizing impact and directness.
A stark, high-contrast black and white color scheme is used throughout, with minimal accents, reinforcing a sophisticated and direct aesthetic.
The initial introductory content (small logo, label, text, small image) completely disappears on scroll, replaced by a full-screen, large-type content block with a new image.
The brand logo at the bottom of the page features a persistent, animated glitch or scanline effect, giving it a dynamic, digital texture.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered full-screen content transition where an initial introductory screen is entirely replaced by a new, dominant content section as the user scrolls. This is likely achieved by animating the opacity and position of the initial elements out of view, while simultaneously animating the new content into view, potentially using CSS keyframes or JavaScript-driven animations.
The brand logo incorporates a continuous, subtle glitch or scanline animation, likely using CSS keyframes or a canvas element to create a dynamic, digital texture.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with a clean, modern body font, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (no visible rounded corners on major elements), maintaining a crisp and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with content centered and surrounded by vast amounts of negative space, creating a strong sense of focus and luxury.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extreme minimalism combined with a dramatic, full-screen content replacement on scroll creates a highly focused and impactful narrative experience. The glitching brand logo adds a unique digital signature, setting it apart from typical clean and modern designs.
